body.name: Variable-mass ordinal threshold cuts
body.construction: For every \(x\in\mathcal X\), define \(B_{xk}=\sum_{i>k}u_{xi}+\sum_{j\le k}v_{xj}\) for \(k=-1,\ldots,K-1\), and \(G_{xk}=\sum_{i<k}u_{xi}+\sum_{j>k}v_{xj}\) for \(k=0,\ldots,K\), with all sums restricted to \(i,j\in\mathcal Y\) and empty sums equal to zero.
